reasons: The Warsaw Pact's troops have crossed the north-eastern border: the 7th Motor Rifle Division leaves Kesmark tonight for its war plan's area on the Rava gorge and Dravec, and the regiment marches with it.
The dam holds the reservoir above Dravec and carries the gorge road: its loss floods the valley the division is to defend.
The Pact's aviation will come low down the gorge from the border range; the S-125 at the dam cannot see below the gorge's sides.

situation.text: fighter-bombers low down the gorge from the border range
a stand-off jammer's orbit beyond the border

habits: The Pact's aviation strikes in massed blows behind jamming, then hunts our air defences with anti-radiation missiles.
